segments.oily: Reviewers with oily-leaning or oily/dry combination skin report it balances shine without adding grease, though one notes her face feels oily by day's end despite this being described as manageable.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as effectively hydrating, softening, and in one case healing dryness quickly, though one dry-skin user finds it too light for winter needs.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those with dry and oily zones on the same face, say it balances both areas without over-drying or over-oiling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no burning, irritation, or breakouts and call it their best option, while others describe stinging, a red itchy rash, bumps, or drying out on the forehead.
segments.normal: One reviewer recommends it for normal to dry skin as very moisturizing.
segments.mature: One reviewer with rosacea and redhead skin in her 30s finds it gentle enough for regular use but not fully absorbing and insufficient alone in winter.

concerns.aging: Not substantively discussed by reviewers beyond one mature-skin user's general satisfaction; no specific anti-aging claims reported.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority report strong, lasting hydration and improved softness; one reviewer notes it fails to fully hydrate during winter or low-humidity conditions without pairing another product.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports no irritation or burning; another reviewer with unspecified sensitive skin reports a red, itchy, bumpy rash after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with amazingly restoring the skin barrier; no other barrier-specific comments appear.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it healed her skin texture after a prior skin issue and did not clog pores; no other spot/texture-repair comments appear.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts, including switching from Proactiv or from acne-prone routines with no reaction; one reviewer nonetheless developed a rash and bumps, and one found it stung initially.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it leaves skin non-greasy and matte-feeling even in summer; one reviewer notes her skin feels oily by the end of the day despite otherwise liking the product.

extraits.titre: My Skin Did Not Like This
extraits.texte: I got a trial size version to travel with and boy, was that a mistake. I did not have an immediate reaction but soon found that a red, itchy rash had broken out on my face. My skin became bumpy and irritated. I did not change anything else about my skincare routine. Beware if you have sensitive skin. Other reviews have mentioned this but gotten downvoted. This is my own experience and may not be everyone else's.

extraits.titre: Don't buy this if you have sensitive skin!!!
extraits.texte: If you have really sensitive skin i don't recommend this product. I used it once and it already has dried out my forehead . So no i will not be repurchasing.

For the price, I do like this product. I have to be careful with my skin, as I've developed rosacea in my 30s and I have redhead skin. I do understand the reviews that mention that it pills and it doesn't feel like it completely absorbs into the skin. Ultimately I prefer gel moisturizers. BUT, because of the gentle ingredients, I like to keep this moisturizer in my lineup during summer and specifically at nights, (due to the pilling) and it does not exactly provide the moisturizing I need during winter months. It's good for 1 year after opening, so I'll keep it around to use occasionally or if I run out of my more expensive products. I like to use a few moisturizers in rotation that my skin agrees with throughout the year, as I feel like it helps my skin not get too used to any 1 specific product. All in all, not a terrible product but not life changing. But for the ingredients, price, size and pump, I'll reuse this until it expires or runs out. **I've never noticed burning from this product and I have incredibly sensitive skin**

I have been using the Bubble Slam Dunk moisturizer daily for a couple months now and my skin looks and feels great! For what seemed like a basic, everyday moisturizer I'm quite impressed by the results. I have sensitive combination skin that leans oily and this has really done a great job of balancing that out with the dry areas. I wore it most of the summer in southwest Florida and have not found it to be too heavy or greasy even during the hottest months. The price is great too! I will definitely purchase this again.

extraits.titre: Really great, especially for the price
extraits.texte: I have dry skin and live far enough north to have legitimate (very low humidity) winters. I'd give it a 9/10 in the summer and a 7/10 in the winter, on its own. Paired with my moisturizing sunscreen my face is plenty hydrated.

This product is one THE BEST moisturizer on the market! I loved how it worked on my skin. I'm prone to an occasional pimple here and there and the entire time that I used this product, I never had one pimple! For some weird reason, I thought I could switch it up and I purchased Mositure Surge by a major makeup manufacturer and I had a pimple to occur. Plus the Moisture Surge product didn't last very long. I quickly realized that Bubble worked the best and I repurchased again.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again and again and again
extraits.texte: I love this product because I have dry and sensitive skin and it never broke me out, also it's moisturizes the skin barrier AMAZINGLY yet it not thick but it's not light weight overall I think you guys should try it
